title: $2$-word-$π$-representable Graphs
summary: This paper investigates the new notion of $2$-word-$π$-repre\-sentable graphs: the nodes of the graph correspond to the letters of the two words and there exists an edge between two nodes if the projections of any two letters of both words are equal. The benefit of not only using one word for a representation as introduced by Kitaev and Pyatkin is that every graph is $2$-word-$π$-representable.
